account.overview.title: Account overview
account.overview.description: Your balance, open bets and recent activity. Every figure is simulated.
account.kyc.title: Account not verified
account.kyc.notStarted: No identity or age verification has taken place. This build has no verification provider connected — a licensed one would have to confirm your identity before an account could stake or withdraw real money.
account.balance.title: Balance
account.bets.title: My bets
account.bets.description: Every ticket you have placed in this demonstration. Select a multiple to see its legs.
account.bets.emptyDescription: Bets you place will appear here.
account.transactions.title: Transactions
account.transactions.description: A simulated ledger. Every entry is generated by the app; no money has moved.
account.notifications.description: Match reminders, bet settlements and account notices.
account.profile.title: Profile
account.profile.description: Your account details. In this demonstration nothing is saved.
account.profile.saveNotice: Your username and the rest of your account are managed by your manager.
account.security.title: Security
account.security.description: Your password and the devices signed in to your account.
account.security.passwordBody: Choose a long, unique password. It is stored only as an Argon2id hash — nobody, including administrators, can read it.
account.security.twoFactorBody: An additional code at sign-in. Not available yet.
account.security.sessionsBody: Devices signed in to this account. Sign out of any you don’t recognise.
account.responsible.title: Responsible gambling
account.responsible.description: Your limits and break options, in one place.
account.error.restricted: This account cannot place bets right now.
account.error.verificationRequired: Your account must be verified before you can bet.
notify.newPlayer.title: New player
notify.accountLocked.title: Account temporarily locked
notify.accountLocked.body: {username} was locked after repeated failed sign-ins.
notify.passwordChanged.title: Password changed
notify.passwordChanged.body: Your password was changed and other devices were signed out. If this wasn’t you, contact support.
notify.withdrawalRequest.title: Withdrawal request
notify.approvalRequest.title: Approval needed
notify.approvalRequest.body: A {amount} TND adjustment for {username} is waiting for a second administrator.
notify.largeTransaction.title: Large transaction
notify.balanceUpdated.title: Balance updated
notify.balanceUpdated.credit: {amount} TND was added to your account.
notify.balanceUpdated.debit: {amount} TND was deducted from your account.
notify.withdrawalDecision.title: Withdrawal update
notify.withdrawalDecision.approved: Your withdrawal of {amount} TND was approved.
notify.withdrawalDecision.rejected: Your withdrawal of {amount} TND was declined and the funds were returned to your balance.
notify.betSettled.title: Bet settled
notify.exclusion.title: Break started
notify.exclusion.body: Your cooling-off or self-exclusion is now active. You can still sign in and withdraw.
account.kyc.not_started: Your identity and age have not been verified. Your date of birth is a self-declaration. Verification is a manual review by the operator until a verification provider is connected.
account.kyc.rejected: Your verification was not accepted. Contact support.
account.kyc.expired: Your verification has expired. Contact support to renew it.
account.security.forcedBody: This account was given an initial password. Replace it before doing anything else.
account.security.passwordChanged: Password changed. Other devices were signed out.
account.security.revokeOthers: Sign out of all other devices
account.security.otherSessionsRevoked: All other devices were signed out
account.error.wageringBlocked: Betting is blocked on this account. Contact support.
notify.creditReceived.title: Credit received
notify.creditReceived.body: {amount} TND of credit was added to your balance.
notify.creditFromManager.title: Credit added
notify.creditFromManager.body: Your manager added {amount} TND to your balance.
notify.creditRequest.title: Credit request
notify.creditRequest.body: {username} is asking for {amount} TND of credit.
notify.creditRequestRejected.title: Credit request declined
notify.creditRequestRejected.body: Your manager did not approve your request for {amount} TND.
